title: Plastic Man #9 10 11 12 13 14 Lot DC Comics 2004-2005 Kyle Baker Run
conditionDescription: All six covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Plastic Man #9, #10, #11, #12, #13 and #14 (October 2004 - March 2005), DC Comics - six consecutive issues from Kyle Baker's Eisner Award-winning Plastic Man series. $2.95 cover price each.

You get all 6 issues:
- #9 (Oct 2004) - Kyle Baker ventriloquist cover; back cover: Dairy Queen Oreo Scoopables ad
- #10 (Nov 2004) - Kyle Baker arm-wrestling cover; back cover: The Batman Kids' WB premiere ad
- #11 (Dec 2004) - Kyle Baker "Homeland Security" cover; back cover: Campbell's SouperStar Castle ad
- #12 (Jan 2005) - Scott Morse guest issue and cover; back cover: Ty the Tasmanian Tiger 2 video game ad
- #13 (Feb 2005) - Kyle Baker cover; back cover: Wrigley's Hubba Bubba Max gum ad
- #14 (Mar 2005) - Kyle Baker crossing-guard cover; back cover: ZipZaps micro RC RadioShack ad

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
